s1.desc: an empty space with a plain pale grey background

beats.text: Pax turns from facing the side to face forward, blinking his eyes shut
Pax clasps his flippers at his chest and glances around with raised eyebrows
Pax shuffles a little to the right with his flippers clasped, glancing nervously to the side
Pax turns to the right and creeps forward, leaning ahead with his flippers held out
Polly dashes in from the left behind Pax, holding a butterfly net
Polly swings the butterfly net and scoops Pax up into it
Polly holds the net out beside her while Pax sits caught inside it, wriggling
Pax springs up out of the net into the air
Pax lands beside the empty net and squats down with his flippers spread while Polly stares
Polly backs away to the left, dragging the empty net out of view, while Pax starts waddling, facing right

spans.notes: the whole skit is one locked shot on a plain flat background (profile: no cuts; motion cannot fit a plain ground). Judged by eye and by a foreground-bbox track: every shadow sits on the same ground line (y 310/480) the whole skit, character heights stay the same (Pax 114 px f0, 111 px f110), and Pax's standing position f3-24 does not drift. Split at f106 only so Polly's exit (f102) and re-entry (f119) can be recorded. Top third and bottom fifth have no overlay on any frame (edge scan every 5 frames) | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v11): camera: the ground is perfectly plain (std 0.00 in the top 30% and bottom 25% on every 10th frame), so no pan could show; shadows and character heights constant: static; no overlay anywhere (top third and bottom fifth are flat 227 on every frame checked); beat [95,106): Pax does not waddle to the right. He turns right at f94 and walks in place (6-frame foot cycle) while drifting LEFT (centre x 0.7

beats.text: Pax keeps waddling along facing right with his flippers held out in front of him
Polly rushes in from the left carrying a big cardboard box
Polly scoops Pax into the cardboard box, his feet sticking up as he tumbles in
Polly pushes the box upright and turns to face forward beside it
Polly tosses a bag of chips, a soda can, a game console and a book into the box
Polly rubs her flippers together at her chest beside the open box, glancing sideways
Polly reaches over and folds the box flaps shut
Polly swings the box around to her other side while Pax's head peeks up out of it
Polly leans over the box and presses its flaps down with both flippers
Polly turns to the front with one flipper on the box and a roll of tape behind her
Polly walks around the box wrapping strip after strip of tape across it
Polly turns to the front and holds up a yellow pencil
Polly pokes a row of holes into the side of the box with the pencil, sweat drops on her head
Polly tucks the pencil away and stands with a flipper on the taped box, sweating
Polly wipes her brow with a flipper
Polly flicks the sweat off her flipper and glances at the box
Polly rests a flipper on the box and smiles with her eyes closed
